messages:
Sam (Docs): Quick find while updating the v1->v2 migration page: swapping embedding aliases can change vector dims (1024 -> 1536) and break client indexes. We need a tiny deprecation note + migration checklist.
Aria (SDK): Yikes. Can you paste a minimal (truncated) repro so we can include a snippet to detect size mismatches?
Sam (Docs): Truncated repro below (do not include full vectors in docs):
```
POST /v2/embeddings
body: {\"model\": \"alias:embed-app\", \"input\": \"hi\"}
response: {\"data\": [{\"embedding\": [ ...1536 floats... ]}]}
```
Ken (Eng): Expected if alias moves to a new family. Infra should expose model.metadata.vector_dim so docs/SDK can show exact dims. I'll open INF-997.
Aria (SDK): We'll add a small snippet and unit test. Proposed snippet for docs (language-agnostic):
```
resp = client.embeddings.create(...)
dim = len(resp.data[0].embedding)
if dim != expected_dim:
    raise RuntimeError("embedding size mismatch; pin model or reindex")
```
Lina (ProductOps): Product wants: 1) short banner near migration guide, 2) 3-step recipe (sample test, compare dims, reindex/pin), 3) a FAQ line.
Sam (Docs): Draft banner: "Warning: swapping an embedding model alias can change vector dimensionality. Verify embedding size (vector dim) before updating index schemas."
Aria (SDK): SDK action: add optional auto-check that compares returned dim with model_catalog.vector_dim and warns. I'll include JS/Python/Go snippets.
Ken (Eng): Also add a docs redirect: old sample apps that assume 1024 should point to a migration note. Sam, can you search for examples with `expected_dim=1024` and include links in the PR?
Sam (Docs): On it. I'll run a quick grep across the repo and list matches in the PR. I'll also avoid full arrays and use `[...1536 floats...]` as placeholders.
docs-bot: created task DOCS-1366 "embed-dim-migration-note" assigned to @Sam,@Aria,@Ken,@Lina due in 7 days.
Lina (ProductOps): Good. If telemetry shows >1% impacted customers, we'll include the banner in the v1->v2 deprecation email.
Aria (SDK): One more idea: add a small linter rule for example apps that flags hardcoded expected_dim values — would catch many docs breakages. Filing SDK-658.
Sam (Docs): Thanks team. I'll open PR with banner, migration checklist, FAQ, snippets, and a list of example files to update. Ping me for wording reviews. :white_check_mark:
